flow_bearing_day_definition: A date inside a segment's start-to-end window on which the SERVED daily series (column flow of the daily gold series in worker 108's read table) is non-zero, read on the served side only. Distinct (account, date) pairs: a day shared by two segments of one account would count once (no overlap occurred: the per-segment sum is also 234). Segments per account: at most 2.
closes_note: both = closes under START and MID; start_only and mid_only exclude the other; none of the 51 closes under END. Placement by the exactly-one rule: 47 not determined, 3 START, 1 MID, END 0.
agrees_basis: Re-derived from worker 108's per-segment tables with the rule of the class proposal's script (START/MID/END relink, 0.35 pp tolerance, four dollar items tie, flow-day sets equal): the rule places exactly the 51 listed segments, END closes 0, START 50, MID 48, and the placement is 47 not determined, 3 START, 1 MID, matching the record. The record's 235 flow days (ledger side, 50 of 51 segments reproduce) differ from the 234 served-side days counted here by one; this record does not decide that day.

The bar as written is met. This record names no winner and ranks no convention; note that 47 of the 51 close under both START and MID, so the count does not separate those two.
